subject: Proposal: invoice rhythm & FX margin handling — Helios Bio
messages:
From: Sophie Barnes <sophie.barnes@heliosbio.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 08:12:00 +0200
Subject: Proposal: Adjusted invoice cadence + FX margin handling

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Helios is excited about the latency gains we saw. Finance asked me to send a short proposal for the commercial side while we finish procurement approvals. The ask is: can Redwood accommodate a stretched remit schedule for the first 6 months of the rollout due to a constrained budget cycle? Rough outline below: 

- Proposed payment rhythm: 50% on activation, 30% at month 2, 20% at month 4 (effectively stretching payments across 90 days).
- We need invoices in EUR; our treasury requires a +/-1.5% FX tolerance on month-end settlements (we can accept a small FX margin on invoices to avoid repeated reconciliations).
- PO: HEL-PO-6347 (attached).

This is time-sensitive — procurement wants a cleared approach by end of week to include in their next vendor slate. Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through.

Attachments: Helios_Proposed_Payment_Plan_2027-07.pdf, HEL-PO-6347 (attached as helios_po_6347.pdf)

Thanks,
Sophie Barnes
Head of Procurement — Helios Bio

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 10:18:00 +0200
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: Adjusted invoice cadence + FX margin handling

Team — forwarding Helios' ask (attached). Key points: they want to stretch payment timing for six months (50% on activation, remainder stretched to ~90 days) and to handle EUR invoices with a small FX margin instead of ongoing reconciliations. PO attached for reference.

Quick questions:
- Is there appetite to offer a phased remit (short-term pilot terms) while protecting DSO/cash?
- Finance: what floor for an upfront deposit would you want to de-risk?
- Sales: any reason to avoid FX pass-through vs. fixed margin?

My thinking: compromise with Net45 + 20% activation deposit, and pass-through on FX with monthly reconciliation, or a capped FX margin (e.g., 1.25%). If we're going to accept stretched timing, we should tie it to a credit cap (e.g., $150k) and require DocuSign SOW addendum.

I can draft the revised schedule for signature. Please reply quick — procurement expects an answer by Friday EOD.

Attachments: helios_po_6347.pdf

Thanks,
Naomi
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 14:04:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Adjusted invoice cadence + FX margin handling

Naomi — agree with your suggested compromise. Operational guardrails I'd propose: 

- Offer Net45 for invoices after activation, but require 20% upfront deposit at activation (applied to first invoice).
- Put a rolling credit cap of $150,000 (reduces risk to finance). If consumption reaches 80% of the cap, trigger automatic pause + sales/finance notification.
- For EUR invoices: allow FX pass-through with monthly reconciliation; alternatively, apply a fixed FX margin of 1.25% if they prefer no monthly adjustments.
- Require DocuSign amendment (SOW addendum) and a purchase order acknowledgement to lock terms.

Finance (Marissa) — can you confirm that $150k cap + 20% deposit is acceptable from a cashflow/collections perspective? If needed we can ask for an interim escrow hold for enterprise pilot customers in EU.

If all good, Naomi — draft the schedule and send back to Sophie with DocuSign link. I'll approve discount/credits if needed to land the pilot.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Director, Enterprise Sales
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Barnes <sophie.barnes@heliosbio.com>
Cc: Helios AP <ap@heliosbio.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Proposal: Adjusted invoice cadence + FX margin handling

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear proposal and the PO. After discussing with my finance and sales leads, here's a suggested path forward we can sign off quickly: 

1) Payment cadence: Net45 on all invoices after activation. To reduce initial exposure we require a 20% activation deposit (deducted from first invoice).
2) Credit cap: rolling exposure capped at $150,000 for the first 6 months; when consumption reaches 80% of the cap, we'll pause new provisioning and notify both teams to agree next steps.
3) FX handling: we can either pass-through actual EUR->USD rate with monthly reconciliations OR apply a fixed FX margin of 1.25% on EUR invoices to avoid ongoing reconciliations — tell us which you prefer.
4) Governance: sign a simple DocuSign SOW addendum to record terms and attach the PO acknowledgement.

I've attached a revised schedule and a DocuSign link to the addendum for review: https://docusign.net/helios/6347/agree. If that looks good, we'll countersign the PO and get the activation deposit arranged. Happy to do a 20-minute call to close this out.

Attachments: redwood_revised_schedule_2027-07.xlsx, docusign_agreement_helios_6347.pdf

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
